svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A plywood tube 310 x 640 mm outside, 150 mm deep, with a top plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Long sides: two 640 x 150 mm. Short sides: two 274 x 150 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: glued and screwed between the long sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top plate 310 x 640 mm. Cut two 250 mm round holes, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across the 310 mm width and 160 mm each side of the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glue and screw the plate on top of the tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the tube drops into the fan bay from above, its bottom edge

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flush with the joist undersides (the room ceiling). Four screws

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through each long side into the joist beside it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The plate stands 30 mm above the ceiling boards.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: square; plate flat; seal the joints with sealant.
